title: Halcyon Drift Rising Again
author: Juniper Oyelaran
blurb: Ansel Fairweather, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
